info.name: TikTok Filter Generator API
info.description: Documentation for the implemented Laravel API only. 26 requests cover all 24 route entries, with separate PUT and PATCH examples. Import the accompanying environment and follow postman/README.md. Bearer auth is inherited by protected requests; authentication entry points and the gallery explicitly disable auth. Saved examples use synthetic IDs, timestamps and placeholder tokens, not live data. Fill email/password locally, select existing category/tag IDs, and choose an upload file. Requests are intended for manual exploration: delete/logout operations are destructive and folder order is not an end-to-end runner workflow. Responses vary with data and ownership; each saved example is an independent scenario.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register or log in first. Successful responses save token in collection variables. Email/password values are deliberately blank; fill them locally. Login: 5 requests/minute per normalized email + IP, plus 30/minute per IP; registration: 5/minute per IP.

request.description:
Public; no authentication required.

Required name (string, max 255), unique valid email (max 255), confirmed password (min 8 characters; max 72 bytes with the default bcrypt driver; overall max 4096 characters; no null bytes). Returns a user and a new token. Use a fresh email. The password is never returned.

item.name: Filters
item.description: Private CRUD for the authenticated user's own filters. Other users' filters return 403 here even when published; use Public Gallery to browse public content. Creation always starts draft with published_at null. Name: required on creation, string max 255. Category: existing integer category_id, required on creation. Description: nullable string max 10000. Tags: optional list of up to 50 distinct existing tag IDs. Layers: optional list of up to 100 objects containing only type, asset_id, layer_order, properties. Type: adjustment, sticker, overlay or text. layer_order: integer 0–4294967295. properties: required nonempty JSON object/array; keys are application-defined. asset_id: nullable existing asset belonging to the authenticated user; updates also allow references already inherited by this filter. Category/tag examples require existing database rows; no category/tag management endpoints exist. Upload an asset first to populate asset_id, or use null. Do not submit user_id, parent_filter_id, status or published_at.

item.name: Assets
item.description: Private uploads only. No asset download, listing or deletion API currently exists. Stored paths and public URLs are never returned.

request.description:
Requires Bearer {{token}} (inherited from the collection).

Required multipart fields: type (sticker or overlay) and file (PNG, JPG/JPEG or WEBP image). Max 5120 KiB (5 MiB), width/height each 1–4096 pixels, original filename max 255 characters. Actual image content is validated; SVG/GIF are rejected. Choose a file in Postman; let Postman generate the multipart Content-Type boundary. Ownership comes from the token; user_id is prohibited. Random stored filenames on private storage; failed database writes clean up the file. Limited to 10 requests/minute per authenticated user. Saves asset_id on success.

item.name: Public Gallery
item.description: Public endpoints explicitly use No Auth. Only status=published AND published_at not null are visible. Creator fields are id and name only; no email. Includes likes_count, category, tags, ordered layers and safe asset metadata.

query.description: Optional name/description search; enable to filter.

request.description:
Public; no authentication required.

Newest published_at first, then newest ID. Fixed 15 per page. Enable any optional query parameters below: search matches name OR description using a bound LIKE pattern (SQL % and _ wildcards are active); category/tag filters combine with AND. Search: nullable string max 255. IDs: nullable existing integers. Page: integer >=1. Filtering parameters are preserved in pagination links.

item.name: AI Recommendations
item.description: Authenticated published-filter recommendations based on likes, saved collections, categories and tags. AI ranking is optional; deterministic fallback works without a provider key. Rate limit: 10 requests/minute per user.

request.description:
Requires a Sanctum Bearer token ({{token}}). No request body or query parameters. Limited to 10 requests per minute per authenticated user.

Returns up to five published filters (status=published and published_at is not null), based on the user's likes, filters saved in collections, and their categories and tags. Unseen filters from other creators take priority; previously liked/saved or owned filters fill shortages. Drafts are never returned.

AI ranks candidates when a provider key/model is configured on the server and the user has published preference history. Missing configuration, provider errors/timeouts, or unusable output use deterministic fallback: category matches, shared-tag count, likes count, then publication recency and ID. New users receive popularity/recency fallback without an LLM call. No LLM key is needed to test fallback; never add provider keys to Postman.

Response: data is an array of FilterResource objects with creator id/name, category, tags, layers, safe asset metadata and likes_count. meta.source is ai when a valid AI choice is returned (other slots may use fallback), otherwise fallback. Results are not paginated; an empty eligible catalog returns data: []. Saved examples are independent synthetic scenarios.

401: missing or invalid token. 429: rate limit exceeded; respect Retry-After (seconds).

response.name: 200 AI recommendations
